reviewContext.userProblem: The menu-bar status item always shows the budget text '<cost> · <pct>' and the Claude Code / Codex rate-limit pies have no ratio text. The user wants to show only the Claude weekly and Codex weekly pies with their ratios ('Claude W n% · Codex W n%') and hide the budget pie and budget text, and to toggle per-pie ratio text on the dashboard.

designDecisionsAndRationale: RatioTextSelection is separate from PieChartSelection because the latter coerces [] to [budget] (R1).
The budget segment is the exact string passed to updateStatusTitle today, so warning markers move with budget text (R4) and the default is byte-identical.
Composition is a pure AppCore function so it is unit-testable; the menu-bar target has no test target.
The dashboard stores a hidden-set (default []) so old state renders and validates unchanged (R7).
intentionalTradeoffs: The menu-bar wiring (rt-03) is verified by compilation, lint, line count and grep checks; the GUI check is optional and may be recorded as skipped.
Hiding budget text also hides the '$!' / ' !' markers; the warning remains in the tooltip, accessibility label and budget-pie triangle (R4).
supportedEdgeCases: Empty ratio selection gives a glyph-only title; accessibility value is '' while the pie image description still lists values.
A newly toggled rate-limit label shows '--' until the next fetch completes.
A key holding only unknown values in state.json decodes to [].
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Showing ratio text for Codex otherWindows or Claude per-model sub-limits.
Sharing the ratio selection between the menu bar and the dashboard.
